name: whitelistvideo-parent-guide
description: Read-only WhitelistVideo setup and playback help for parents.

interface.longDescription:
Use this plugin to learn about WhitelistVideo, follow device setup steps, and search reviewed playback help. It provides general guidance for parents, not live access to a family account.

WhitelistVideo is a whitelist-based YouTube parental control for kids ages 8-15. It blocks every video by default, and parents approve the channels their child can watch. YouTube's recommendations still work, shaped by the channels a parent approves. Shorts are off by default, so children are not placed in an endless short-form feed.

WhitelistVideo works alongside Apple Screen Time, Google Family Link, and Microsoft Family Safety. Those tools set how long a child can use a device. WhitelistVideo decides what plays on YouTube.

It works on Windows, Mac, Chromebook, iPhone, iPad, Android phones and tablets, Android TV, and Apple TV.

This ChatGPT plugin offers public setup and playback help only. It cannot access your family account, check live protection, approve channels, or change settings. Use the Parent app for those actions.

Learn more at https://whitelist.video.
